items.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
items.description: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

items.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
items.description: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.

items.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
items.description: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

items.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
items.description: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.

items.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
items.description: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono puts out a statement through his club, expressing his sorrow and pain after Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel's death.

items.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
items.description: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

items.title: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force
items.description: On Wednesday morning, Delhi's air quality index reading stood at 377, in the "very poor" category.

items.title: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism
items.description: Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish.

items.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
items.description: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.

items.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
items.description: As South Africans vote in local elections, residents tell the BBC they are tired of the poor quality of services they get.

items.title: Nadal set to join Real Madrid board of directors
items.description: Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid.

items.title: Sharp objects found in Halloween sweets in three European nations
items.description: Dozens of cases are reported in Austria, Germany and Hungary, including a nine-year-old girl hurting her tongue while eating chocolate containing a pin.
